name: PromoCard
summary: An image + text promo card, 6 responsive breakpoints and 5 states.
capturedNotes: Focus's border treatment is inconsistent across breakpoints — some get an extra black inner border, some don't.
1400/Active hard-codes its image markup differently from 1400/Default — an export inconsistency, not a design choice.
"Variant11" only exists in the Focus state with no Default/Hover/Active counterpart — looks like an incomplete exploration frame.
